tooltip: "Packed to the brim with totems used by the centaur as currency. Delivering this to one of the rivaling clans is sure to earn their favor."

items.name: Parcel of Mail
tooltip: "Letters and packages for delivery to Everlook."

items.name: Parcel of Mail
tooltip: "Letters and packages for delivery to Mount Hyjal."

items.name: Vial of Earth Song Water
tooltip: Use: Summon a torrential downpour of enchanted water to extinguish Woodwyrd.
"A single vial of this mystical water can bring about a torrent of rainfall."

items.name: Flight Log
tooltip: "The journal is filled with atmospheric weather and rocket staging information"

items.name: Lucky Lure
tooltip: "Covered in the guts of countless swamp fish"

items.name: Uthek's Draenethyst Staff
tooltip: Use: Attempt to dispel the necromantic curse on buried undead.

items.name: Al'Alketh Cultist's Ear
tooltip: "You can't help but wonder what the Nightclaw plan to do with all these ears?"

items.name: Gimashi's Findings
tooltip: "The notes are written in multiple colors of ink, a sign of a long study."

items.name: Spectral Iron Ore
tooltip: "Simply iron ore, though bound to the spirit realm."

items.name: Vindael's Spectral Pickaxe
tooltip: "Reveals Ghostly Iron Deposits while in your inventory. Also serves as a regular mining pick!"

items.name: Wide-Brimmed Fishing Hat
tooltip: Use: Attach a lure to your equipped fishing pole, increasing Fishing by 25 for 10 min.

items.name: Deep-Sea Waders
tooltip: Use: Lets you walk on water for 1 min.

items.name: Tusk Ring
tooltip: "This was a troll's tusk ring. It was clearly well-loved once, but that was long ago."

items.name: Darkblade
tooltip: Chance on hit: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy causing 105 to 175 Shadow damage.

items.name: Highborne Research Tablet
tooltip: Equip: Chance on hit to deal 69 to 81 Arcane damage. Deals 2 times as much damage to Naga and Satyrs.

items.name: Scribbled Directions to Sulfur Vents
tooltip: "A hastily-scrawled list of locations for prospecting."

items.name: Virulent Blood of Agamaggan
tooltip: "Whether it is actually the blood of the fallen god is unclear, but what is certain is how eager it seems to escape the vial."

items.name: Vibrant Flower
tooltip: Use: Assemble 5 Vibrant Flowers to create a Benevolent Bouquet.
"Its beauty is a stark contrast from the gardens in which it grew."

items.name: Forlorn Necklace
tooltip: "Once an enchanted necklace that sustained life in the gardens of Shen'dralas. Whatever magic it once contained has since been depleted."

items.name: Hyjal Postal Satchel
tooltip: "Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night..."

items.name: Barely Legible Journal Entry, Page I
tooltip: Use: Add a missing page to Evenshade's journal.

items.name: Candied Fruit Sampler
tooltip: Use: Restores 162 health over 27 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

items.name: Pristine Peach
tooltip: Use: Restores 232 health over 30 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

items.name: Garnished Rice Cake
tooltip: Use: Restores 232 health over 30 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

items.name: Savory Shen'dralar Steak
tooltip: Use: Restores 358 health over 30 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

items.name: Stuffed Pumpkin
tooltip: Use: Restores 358 health over 30 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

items.name: Spectral Spirits
tooltip: Use: A fairly weak alcoholic beverage.

items.name: SAF-T Tabs
tooltip: "SAF-T brand tabs make it SAF to hand out dynamite to all your friends!"

items.name: SAF-T Dynamite
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 26 to 34 Fire damage in a 5 yard radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

items.name: SAF-T Copper Bomb
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 22 to 28 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 3 yard radius for 1 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)
"SAF-T Brand bombs *almost* never blow up in your hands (or your paws!)"

items.name: EZ-Thro Copper Bomb XL
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 43 to 57 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yard radius for 1 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

items.name: No Slip SAF-T Padding
tooltip: "SAF-T Padding prevents those easy throwing accidents."

items.name: SAF-T Bronze Bomb
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 73 to 97 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 3 yard radius for 2 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

items.name: SAF-T Jumbo Dynamite
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 128 to 172 Fire damage in a 5 yard radius. (1 Min Cooldown)
"If it's easy to throw, it's not SAF-T!"

items.name: SAF-T Bell
tooltip: "Do you know where your Sheep is?! SAF-T Knows."

items.name: Shafety Sheep
tooltip: Use: Summons an Explosive Sheep which will charge at a nearby enemy and explode for 135 to 165 damage. Lasts for 3 min or until it explodes. (1 Min Cooldown)
"Guaranteed to blow up only where it's SAF!"

items.name: EZ-Thro Bronze Mortar
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 85 to 115 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yard radius for 2 sec. Any damage will break the effect.

items.name: EZ-Thro Grenade
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 213 to 287 Fire damage in a 5 yard radius. (1 Min Cooldown)
"Who needs safety when it's this easy to throw?"

items.name: SAF-T Bomb
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 149 to 201 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yard radius for 3 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)
"S. A. F. T. B. O. M. B. SAF-T. Bomb."

items.name: Emergency Field Cloak
tooltip: Use: Gives invisibility for 10 sec. (60 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Compact Critter Carrier
tooltip: Use: Place a Compact Critter Carrier for 3 min that allows Hunters in your group to access their stabled pets.

items.name: EZ-Thro Tru-Trigger
tooltip: "EZ to use and almost never misfires!"

items.name: Tru-Trigger Frag Bomb
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 149 to 201 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 8 yard radius for 2 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)
"Tru-Trigger frags enemies, not in your hands."

items.name: SAF-T Disposable Parachute
tooltip: Use: Reduces your fall speed for 10 sec. (30 Min Cooldown)
"SAF-T in case you need to jump."

items.name: Gnomish Army Knife
tooltip: "It's got everything: a spanner, a wrench, a hammer... even a mining pick."

items.name: Loot-A-Rang
tooltip: Use: Retrieves the loot from a nearby corpse. (3 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: SAF-T Tube
tooltip: "Prevents accidental oxygen exposure. That wouldn't be SAF."

items.name: SAF-T Clever Dynamite
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 340 to 460 Fire damage in a 5 yard radius. (1 Min Cooldown)

items.name: EZ-Thro Shell
tooltip: "Encase your explosives in EZ to Thro thorium-plated shells."

items.name: EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 300 to 500 Fire damage and stuns targets for 3 sec in a 3 yard radius. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)

items.name: EZ-Thro Dark Bomb
tooltip: Use: Inflicts 225 to 675 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yard radius for 4 sec. Any damage will break the effect. (1 Min Cooldown)
"So EZ, you can Thro it in the dark."

items.name: EZ-Thro Mana Bomb
tooltip: Use: Burns 675 to 1125 mana from those in the blast radius and does 50% of the mana drained in damage to the target. Also Silences targets in the blast for 5 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

items.name: EZ-Thro Field Transporter: Gadgetzan
tooltip: Use: Safely transport yourself to Gadgetzan in Tanaris! Emphasis on Safe! Yup, nothing bad could ever happen while using this device! (240 Min Cooldown)

items.name: SAF-T Emergency Ripper: Everlook
tooltip: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Everlook in Winterspring. There are technical problems that sometimes occur, but that's what Goblin Engineering is all about! (240 Min Cooldown)

items.name: EZ and SAF Field Transporter: Mt. Hyjal
tooltip: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Kaylaena's Workshop on Mount Hyjal. Technical problems have a high chance to occur with this mad combination of goblin and gnomish engineering. (240 Min Cooldown)
"Not only combining Goblin and Gnome tech, but also combining plans from the EZ-Thro and SAF-T corporations. Who knows if this will even work?"

items.name: Ultrasafe Rechargeable Battery
tooltip: Use: Restores 3 charges to a SAF-T or EZ-Thro brand device in your possession that does not involve explosions. It would be completely Unsafe with explosives. (1 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Dimensional Transporter - Mt. Hyjal
tooltip: Use: Rips the dimensional walls asunder and transports you to Kaylaena's Workshop on Mount Hyjal. Technical problems have a high chance to occur with this mad combination of goblin and gnomish engineering. (240 Min Cooldown)
"A dangerous amalgamation of Goblin and Gnome engineering techniques."

items.name: Gnomish Poultryizer
tooltip: Use: Turns the target into a chicken for 15 sec. Well, that is assuming the transmogrification polarity has not been reversed... (5 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Ultralight Goblin Glider
tooltip: Use: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. (3 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Stealthman 52
tooltip: Use: Cloaks the user in a stealth field for up to 1 min. Cannot be used in combat. The field lasts for up to 6 sec after moving. (5 Min Cooldown)

items.name: SAF-T Nitro Boosts
tooltip: Use: Activate a set of jets to increase your movement speed by up to 160%, for up to 8 sec.

items.name: EZ-Thro Magnetic Displacer
tooltip: Use: Disrupt a magnetic field between you and your nearby enemy target, knocking you both away. Can only affect targets up to 2 levels higher than you. Some targets cannot be displaced. Targets can only be affected by this effect once every 2 min.
"EZ-Thro corporation not responsible for magnets preventing grenades from being thrown."

items.name: Air Construct Core
tooltip: "The glowing orb seems to be looking at you, following your movements with quiet curiosity."

items.name: Crystallized Lightning
tooltip: "The surface of this object is smooth to the touch and makes the hair on the back of your neck stand up when you hold it."

items.name: Enchanted Gyrozephyr
tooltip: "This object softly vibrates, constantly in a state of perpetual motion. If you try to hold it still, the force it exerts increases greatly in intensity."

items.name: Ketharas' Hyjal Stew
tooltip: Use: Restores 735 health and 735 mana over 30 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

items.name: Wind-Infused Bough
tooltip: "Headless wind whistles a soft chill through the enchanted branches."

items.name: Durotar Supply and Logistics Tabard
tooltip: Requires Durotar Supply and Logistics - Exalted

items.name: Reins of the Pack Kodo
tooltip: Use: Summons and dismisses a rideable pack kodo.
"Teaches you how to summon this mount."

items.name: Sealed Apprentice's Writ
tooltip: Use: Tear open the envelope to reveal the writ. The resulting order will be for an Apprentice craftsman.
"A pending crafting order intercepted in transit. Perhaps you can be the means to its end."

items.name: Forger's Quill
tooltip: Use: Rewrite an undesired Craftsman's Writ, resulting in a random writ from the same tier.

items.name: Forged Delivery Receipt
tooltip: Use: Slap a forged delivery receipt onto an empty Waylaid Crate, allowing you to return it to the Azeroth Commerce Authority for +50 reputation.

items.name: Notarized Shipping Container
tooltip: "An empty crate that should be returned to your faction's local trade representatives in the interest of reducing future shipping costs."

items.name: Empty Waterskin
tooltip: Use: Fill with water from the snowmelt pond in front of Deadwood Den.

items.name: Windcharged Leaf
tooltip: Equip: Reduces the mana cost of shapeshifting spells by 40.

items.name: Windcarved Effigy
tooltip: Equip: Reduces the mana cost of Lightning Bolt by 5 mana.

items.name: Mark of Urs'endris
tooltip: Equip: Increases your Armor contribution from items by 4%.

items.name: Firestorm Totem
tooltip: Equip: Reduces the mana cost of your totems by 5%.

items.name: Deadwood Tribal Beads
tooltip: "These may be collected for the Barkskin furbolgs to earn their trust."

items.name: Skywall Souffle
tooltip: Use: Restores 17 health over 18 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 seconds eating you will become well fed and gain 1 Stamina for 15 min.

items.name: Recipe: Skywall Souffle
tooltip: "Teaches you how to cook Skywall Souffle."

items.name: Pincer Bites

items.name: Recipe: Pincer Bites

items.name: Muradin Bronzebeard's Silver Coin
tooltip: "May the Holy Light protect us on our expedition to the frozen north."

items.name: Aegwynn's Silver Coin
tooltip: "I really wish you mages would get your heads out from inside your own... books."

items.name: Alleria's Silver Coin
tooltip: "May my sisters realize their full potential, the name Windrunner known as result of their deeds."

items.name: Antonidas' Silver Coin
tooltip: "Grant me the strength to accept the things that I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can and the wisdom to know the difference."

items.name: Arcanist Doan's Silver Coin
tooltip: "Oh, why won't you notice me? Abbendis, I would follow you anywhere. I wish you would notice me..."

items.name: Fandral Staghelm's Silver Coin
tooltip: "I pray that when the time comes I will have the strength to thwart the forces beyond the gate."

items.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque's Silver Coin
tooltip: "How does this fountain even work? I wonder if I could make one."

items.name: Khadgar's Silver Coin
tooltip: "Turalyon and Alleria, wherever you are, may you be well."

items.name: King Terenas Menethil's Silver Coin
tooltip: "May my son Arthas always act in the best interest of his people."

items.name: Medivh's Silver Coin
tooltip: "<You sense the ringing of three tones in your head, the third barely audible under the others' din.>"

items.name: Prince Magni Bronzebeard's Silver Coin
tooltip: "I hope that my father and brothers outlive me. I'll not make much of a king."

items.name: Anduin Wrynn's Gold Coin
tooltip: "I wish I would grow up, it feels like I've been 10 for years."

items.name: Uther Lightbringer's Gold Coin
tooltip: "Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force."

items.name: Arthas' Gold Coin
tooltip: "Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for?  Perhaps a frozen scone..."

items.name: Arugal's Gold Coin
tooltip: "I wish someday to retire to my own tidy little estate, with a bunch of pet dogs to keep me company."

items.name: Kel'Thuzad's Gold Coin
tooltip: "Sometimes... I wish someone would come along and just give me a big, long hug."

items.name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore's Gold Coin
tooltip: "Arthas, my love, please come back to me."

items.name: Lady Katrana Prestor's Gold Coin
tooltip: "Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you."

items.name: Sylvanas Windrunner's Gold Coin
tooltip: "I hope my sisters and I can grow up and get married together. This coin appears to be very old."

items.name: Tirion Fordring's Gold Coin
tooltip: "It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for."

items.name: Archimonde's Gold Coin
tooltip: "I wish to know how you survived my wrath, little fountain."

items.name: Valdrus Blackthorne's Gold Coin
tooltip: "Explain my dreams little fountain. Why must I always be viewing my kin from above and moving them like pawns?"

items.name: Umbrinoth's Gold Coin
tooltip: "It seems my moonlighting days as a postal worker are coming to an end."

items.name: Thrall's Gold Coin
tooltip: "Grom, may you rest well, old friend."

items.name: Sonya Darkhallow's Gold Coin
tooltip: "This doesn't make sense. Why am I putting a coin in a fountain?"

items.name: Zarla Ober's Gold Coin
